browserObservations.observed: All three featured entries retained the original timeline and short headings. Andalus shows the recovery wireframes and reconstruction caption; Nasaq shows its current conversation, six-icon family, refinement choices and composer with a local-demo caption; Flex shows its saved landing-page headline, supporting panel and primary action. At 300% browser zoom, the narrow Andalus crop focused the changed-fare screen and the Nasaq crop stayed within its frame. The existing footer blur covers content near the lower viewport edge, particularly at high zoom; these crops were inspected by scrolling them into the clearer area. Zoom was restored to 100%. Clicking Nasaq opened its existing language dialog, and closing returned focus to the same Nasaq entry.
browserObservations.result: Observed this desktop preview change and limited high-zoom reflow. Physical mobile, full accessibility, opening-viewport proof and hiring comprehension remain open.
